prompt: Promotions to a higher level should be made from within the company rather than appointing a new person from outside. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Some people believe that companies should promote existing employees to senior positions rather than recruit new people from outside. I strongly agree with this view because current employees already possess valuable knowledge and experience of the company’s operations, and internal promotions can also increase workforce motivation

One major reason why companies should promote existing employees to higher positions is that they already have considerable knowledge and experience of their responsibilities and the company’s operations. This awareness makes them more capable of handling their workload and dealing with workplace challenges. Moreover, since they are already familiar with company policies, clients and working procedures, they may require less training and can adapt to their new roles more quickly. As a result, they can make better decisions and avoid unnecessary mistakes while performing their duties. Ultimately, this can improve the company’s overall efficiency and productivity, leading to greater profitability.

Another reason why companies should promote existing employees is that this practice can increase workers’ motivation. When employees know that their hard work and good performance may lead to promotion, they are more likely to put greater effort into their duties and remain committed to the company. This increased motivation can encourage them to perform their tasks more effectively and consistently. As a result, the overall quality of their work may improve, which can contribute to greater workplace efficiency. Ultimately, promoting employees from within can increase workforce productivity and contribute to the long-term success of the company.

In conclusion, I strongly believe that companies should give preference to existing employees when filling higher-level positions. Their familiarity with business operations enables them to perform effectively, while opportunities for internal promotion can motivate employees to work harder and contribute to greater organisational success.
